## LaunchDarkly (Remote)

LaunchDarkly's hosted MCP server connects AI assistants to feature flags, AgentControl configs, and observability data. Use it to inspect flag configuration and make changes using your LaunchDarkly account permissions.

### Setup

You need a LaunchDarkly commercial account and a member role with access to the relevant projects and environments. Run `thv run launchdarkly-remote --remote-auth` and authorize with LaunchDarkly. Dynamic client registration is supported, so no API key, pre-created OAuth application, or custom headers are required. The hosted server is unavailable for LaunchDarkly EU and Federal environments; use the existing local entry for those environments.

Access follows the role of the member who authorizes the connection. Optional `toolsets` and `writes` URL parameters filter tool discovery but do not enforce account permissions. See the [hosted setup guide](https://launchdarkly.com/docs/home/getting-started/mcp-hosted) for role requirements, connection renewal, and troubleshooting.
